purpose: Governed operational knowledge for provider/runtime troubleshooting. Rules are advisory evidence; they do not mutate permanent routing policy.

symptom: credential accepted on a different Kimi product
lessons.diagnosis: Kimi Platform pay-as-you-go and Kimi Code membership are distinct credential/endpoint products.
remediation: For Kimi Platform credits, prefer moonshot/kimi-* on the Moonshot Platform endpoint.
Use kimi/* only with a compatible Kimi Code membership credential/endpoint.
lessons.safety: Never log or request raw API keys.

symptom: plugin advertises model but models list omits it
lessons.diagnosis: An authored models.providers.moonshot.models list can replace the bundled/discovered provider catalog.
remediation: Inspect models.providers.moonshot.models before reinstalling the plugin.
Remove the authored list or declare all intended models, then refresh the catalog.

symptom: new provider model unavailable after core update
lessons.diagnosis: Core and bundled/global provider plugin versions may be misaligned.
remediation: Inspect packageVersion, builtWithOpenClawVersion, activated and status first.
Update/reinstall only when evidence shows a mismatch.

lessons.diagnosis: 429 can represent TPM, RPM, concurrency, project budget, organization budget, usage-window exhaustion or transient throttling.
remediation: Correlate budget/quota dashboards and provider evidence before labeling the cause.
Suppress retry storms for structural budget/usage-window failures.

symptom: project daily or monthly consumption at configured limit
lessons.diagnosis: Project budget policy can reject otherwise valid K3 requests.
remediation: Wait for the budget window or make an authorized budget adjustment.
Do not treat this as TPM without supporting evidence.

lessons.diagnosis: Native contextWindow and max output tokens are separate controls.
remediation: Preserve the required context window while setting a reasonable per-model maxTokens output budget.
Do not edit provider catalog metadata just to cap output.

symptom: selected model advertises ~1M context but session/preflight still behaves near an older 200k budget
lessons.diagnosis: Session/runtime context metadata may remain stale or capped after a live model switch.
remediation: Inspect status, contextTokens caps and live-switch state.
Preserve the historical session unless evidence requires a new one.

symptom: ChatGPT/Codex access works while OpenAI API billing/quota fails, or vice versa
lessons.diagnosis: ChatGPT/Codex OAuth and OpenAI Platform API keys are distinct credential and billing products.
remediation: Track credential provenance explicitly.
Do not infer API credit availability from a ChatGPT subscription.

symptom: model missing or provider behavior unexpected
lessons.diagnosis: Plugin reinstall is not the first diagnostic step.
remediation: Inspect provider plugin runtime metadata and effective catalog.
Check allowlists, authored provider catalogs, credential provenance and session state before mutation.

lessons.diagnosis: Repeated dispatch can amplify rate limits and cost.
remediation: Open a temporary in-memory circuit after repeated retryable failures or immediately for non-retryable structural incidents.
Use cooldown and a half-open probe; never silently rewrite permanent routing policy.
